manual_all_steps: Open RU/tzp_status.txt. In row `TZP_KEEP`, change the translation to `Готово к выпуску` and change the row status from For Review to Translated.
Use General -> Save. If Save offers both cache-only and file-write options, choose Write to file for this scenario.
Use the dialog copy buttons to copy the project root or inspection path, then open the copied inspection file RU/tzp_status.txt under the scenario project root.
Confirm `TZP_KEEP` now ends with the namespaced comment `-- TZP:TRANSLATED` on disk.
Confirm `TZP_EDIT` still keeps only the user-authored comment `-- заметка переводчика` and did not gain a new TZP comment.
Switch to RU/ui.txt and back to RU/tzp_status.txt to confirm normal editing flow still works.
